name: WorkProof Mission Evaluation Rubric
description: Standardized evaluation rubric separating deterministic ground-truth verification from assistive qualitative reasoning.

deterministicCriteria.name: Functional Correctness & Precision
deterministicCriteria.description: Order math must compute subtotal, apply discounts, and calculate tax with 100% test pass rate.

deterministicCriteria.name: Test Suite Execution
deterministicCriteria.description: Zero runtime exceptions, zero syntax errors, and clean exit code.

assistiveCriteria.name: Technical Explanation & Root Cause Analysis
assistiveCriteria.description: Qualitative evaluation of candidate explanation describing IEEE 754 float precision loss and coupon clamping.

assistiveCriteria.name: Code Maintainability & Cleanliness
assistiveCriteria.description: Assessment of code cleanliness, boundary checks, and naming conventions.

deterministicCriteria.name: State Transition Correctness
deterministicCriteria.description: Component state transitions correctly handle async fetch lifecycles and cache invalidation.

assistiveCriteria.name: Technical Explanation
assistiveCriteria.description: Candidate explanation of state lifecycle and re-render prevention.
